This is be- cause the molecule contains 2 localised regions, one hydrophilic in nature and the other hydrophobic. Non- ionic surfactants differ from anionic surfactants (p.2138) by the absence of charge on, or ionisation of, the molecule; they are generally less irritant than ani- onic or cationic surfactants.
